cards.text: King Solomon of Israel is famous, and word about him travels FAR. It reaches the queen of Sheba, a ruler from another country. Instead of sending a message, she heads straight for Jerusalem.

cards.question: The queen of Sheba has heard all about Solomon's fame. What is she coming to Jerusalem to do?

answers.text: Make a peace treaty with him

cards.text: She arrives in Jerusalem with a very large caravan. And I'm sorry, friend, that is NOT luggage. That's a PARADE.

cards.question: The queen of Sheba's camels are loaded with spices, precious stones and ___ in abundance.
The queen of Sheba talks with Solomon about everything on her mind. True or false: one of her hard questions finally stumps him.

cards.text: Questions answered, the queen does a FULL inspection. Solomon's wisdom, his palace, the food at his table, where his servants sit, what his attendants and cupbearers are wearing, and the burnt offerings he presents at the house of the LORD.

cards.question: The palace, the table, the servants, the offerings. What does all of it do to the queen of Sheba?

cards.text: She tells the king that the report she heard in her own country about his words and wisdom is true. Friend, she showed up to TEST the man and ended up writing him a REVIEW.

cards.question: True or false: the queen of Sheba believed the reports about Solomon before she came and saw him for herself.
Now that the queen of Sheba has seen Solomon with her own eyes, how does he compare to the reports she heard?

cards.text: Then she calls Solomon's servants blessed, the ones who stand before him all the time and hear his wisdom. Meanwhile, my old coworkers were the dead batteries in my junk drawer, arguing over who had the most charge left.

cards.question: After praising Solomon's servants, the queen of Sheba says one more name should be blessed. Whose?

cards.text: She says the LORD delighted in Solomon and set him on His throne, to be king for the LORD his God. She came to test the king, and she ends up pointing right past him to God.

cards.question: The queen of Sheba says that because God loved Israel, He made Solomon king over them to carry out ___ and ___.

cards.text: Then the queen gives the king 120 talents of gold, a great quantity of spices and precious stones. Remember that parade? Turns out it was a DELIVERY.

cards.question: True or false: there had never been spices like the ones the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon.

cards.text: Quick side note: the servants of Hiram, king of Tyre, and Solomon's servants bring algum wood and precious stones back from Ophir. Solomon turns that wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for his palace.

cards.question: Solomon also makes something out of the algum wood for the singers. What does he make?
Before she leaves, King Solomon gives the queen of Sheba whatever she asks for. How does it compare to what she brought him?

answers.text: About the same as she brought

cards.text: Then the queen of Sheba heads back to her own country with her servants. Friend, that's the only trip in history where the souvenirs outweighed the PARADE.
